<template>
	<AsamButton type="default" @click="open('')"> 默认 </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton type="default" @click="open('success')"> 成功 </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton type="default" @click="open('warning')"> 警告 </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton type="default" @click="open('error')"> 错误 </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton type="default" @click="open('info')"> 信息 </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton type="default" @click="openCustomColor"> 自定义颜色 </AsamButton>
	<AsamButton type="default" @click="openWithoutPause"> 悬停时不暂停 </AsamButton>
</template>

<script setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamNotification } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
function open(type) {
	trackAsamNotification(
		AsamNotification({
			title: `${type || 'Default'} progress`,
			message: '鼠标悬停时暂停计时和进度条。',
			type,
			duration: 6000,
			progress: true
		})
	);
}
function openWithoutPause() {
	trackAsamNotification(
		AsamNotification({
			title: '悬停时不暂停',
			message: '鼠标悬停时计时和进度条继续运行。',
			duration: 6000,
			progress: true,
			pauseOnHover: false
		})
	);
}
function openCustomColor() {
	trackAsamNotification(
		AsamNotification({
			title: '自定义颜色',
			message: '自定义进度条颜色覆盖默认颜色。',
			duration: 6000,
			progress: {
				color: [
					{ color: '#f56c6c', percentage: 20 },
					{ color: '#e6a23c', percentage: 40 },
					{ color: '#5cb87a', percentage: 60 },
					{ color: '#1989fa', percentage: 80 },
					{ color: '#6f7ad3', percentage: 100 }
				]
			}
		})
	);
}
const ownedAsamNotification = new Set();
let mountedAsamNotification = true;
const trackAsamNotification = (handle) => {
	if (mountedAsamNotification) ownedAsamNotification.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamNotification = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamNotification) handle.close();
	ownedAsamNotification.clear();
});
</script>
